    [mild] Lemma 1.1: the paths of a mild contour are unique #

    For a contour v, w : x ⇝ y (equal nonzero values, not interlaced) and a non-invertible ρ : y ⟶ y with v̄ ≫ ρ ≠ 0, every path u with ū = v̄ is v or w (MildHyp.path_unique). The contradictions are D̃₄ diagrams MildHyp.not_in3 in P/(v̄ ≫ ρ). Reconstruction: notes/2026-10-30-142400-mild-contours-reconstruction.md.
